title: Michelle Young:
headline: A youth basketball coach says sneakers decide who gets to play, and that the true joy is in giving them away.
story: Michelle runs Homework and Hoops at the Michelle Young Foundation. She knows sneakers are a big reason kids can't play sports, a small thing people take for granted.
Asked if she is happy, she says yes: when you step aside and help someone else, that is true joy. Giving back is the source of her happiness.
She ends on what she saw that day: kids walked in with whatever shoes they had and left running, confident, in front of her face.
